title: upload_blob and download_blob ignore request_timeout
description: ClientConfig.request_timeout doc says it applies to upload_blob and download_blob, but neither blob.rs method calls .timeout(self.config.request_timeout) on the RequestBuilder. A hung server during blob upload or download can block the caller indefinitely, defeating the timeout protection. fetch_session and call both apply the timeout correctly (client.rs lines 167 and 225); blob.rs is missing equivalent .timeout() calls on both the upload POST (line 97) and download GET (line 180).
